![Orientation day - our favourite classroom.](orientation.png)

The first week has been a whirlwind of challenges and delights, but reflection is needed after failing to complete 3 labs and multiple worksheets. The instructors and TAs are fantastic, and my colleagues were bright and encouraging. However, staying late and grinding slowly did not work. 

This week's game plan:
1. Rule 1: Do all worksheets and all labs ASAP.
2. Rule 2: Changes for pre-lecture readings:

i. Math: Ask AI to explain the textbook simply if you struggle with the textbook for 10 minutes.
ii. R: Watch Dr. Timbers's videos first (not the textbook or required readings). 
iii. Platforms: Reading first does not help if you don't understand 80% of it.
iv. Python: Read through ahead of class. Watch a YouTube video ifneed be. Haven't figured this class out.

It feels doom-y, but it's definitely not gloomy. Instructors and students are the highlight of each day. Onwards.
